Main activity: Quartz, copper, specialty minerals and industrial gases
Commercial relationships: Mining, refining, commodity sales and supply contracts
Geographic concentration and examples: Chile: copper. United States: high-purity quartz. China: processing of several critical minerals.
Notes: Concentration differs by material and processing step. High-purity quartz also supplies crucibles used to grow silicon ingots.

Main activity: Electronic-grade silicon, wafers, photoresists and ultrapure chemicals
Commercial relationships: Purification, specialty processing and customer qualification
Geographic concentration and examples: Japan: Shin-Etsu and SUMCO. Other suppliers include GlobalWafers in Taiwan and Siltronic in Germany.
Notes: Electronic-grade silicon and qualified materials are distinct from bulk commodity supply. Company locations indicate headquarters, not every plant.

Main activity: Chip architecture, circuit design and electronic design automation (EDA)
Commercial relationships: Research and development, software licensing and intellectual property (IP)
Geographic concentration and examples: United States: NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Synopsys and Cadence. United Kingdom: Arm.
Notes: Chip designers, EDA vendors and IP licensors perform different roles. The examples are not a market-share ranking.

Main activity: Lithography, etching, deposition, inspection and metrology
Commercial relationships: Equipment sales, maintenance, upgrades and supplier contracts
Geographic concentration and examples: Netherlands: ASML. United States: Applied Materials, Lam Research and KLA. Japan: Tokyo Electron.
Notes: System suppliers depend on specialist components from other countries.

Main activity: Manufacturing logic chips on silicon wafers
Commercial relationships: Foundry contracts, capital investment and yield improvement
Geographic concentration and examples: Taiwan: TSMC. South Korea: Samsung. United States: Intel and TSMC Arizona. China: SMIC.
Notes: These locations and firms do not offer equivalent process technology or capacity. TSMC also manufactures outside Taiwan.

Main activity: High-bandwidth memory (HBM), chip stacking and integration
Commercial relationships: Memory sales, packaging services and capacity reservations
Geographic concentration and examples: SK hynix and Samsung: South Korea headquarters. Micron: United States headquarters. TSMC: Taiwan headquarters.
Notes: Manufacturing spans multiple countries. Memory production and advanced packaging are separate, interdependent activities.

Main activity: Accelerators, processors, switches, storage and racks
Commercial relationships: Hardware sales, contract manufacturing and system integration
Geographic concentration and examples: United States: NVIDIA and Broadcom. Taiwan: Quanta, Wiwynn and Foxconn.
Notes: Headquarters do not identify all assembly locations. Component suppliers and system manufacturers have different roles.

Main activity: Compute clusters, electricity, cooling and connectivity
Commercial relationships: Cloud rentals, infrastructure finance and power purchases
Geographic concentration and examples: United States-headquartered AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud operate across regions.
Notes: Usable capacity depends on local grids, permits, cooling and network connections.

Notes: Examples are not exhaustive. Open-weight and hosted models have different distribution and revenue models.

Main activity: Enterprise tools, consumer products and AI agents
Commercial relationships: Subscriptions, usage fees, licensing and workflow integration
